content:
Based on the information provided, it seems your friend already has a variety of red/burgundy-toned shirts. Therefore, the color that might be most appreciated as a gift would likely be something different, such as white or blue.

Blue could be a good option, as it would provide a contrast to the red/burgundy shirts he already owns. White is also a versatile color that could work well with his existing wardrobe.

Crimson is another reddish-toned color, so it may be too similar to the shirts he already has. Unless you know your friend really likes that specific shade, white or blue would probably be the safer bet for a gift.
